sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.

sources.title: Model releases - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: qwen3.8-max The Qwen3.8 native vision-language Max series model is Qwen's most capable flagship model to date, featuring 2.4 trillion parameters with a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It delivers outstanding performance comparable to the current state-of-the-art models, with significant improvements over the 3.7 series.
